metadata.title: Whittaker vectors in singular Whittaker modules

nodes.name: Whittaker character
nodes.statement: A Lie algebra homomorphism psi: n -> C is called a Whittaker character. The character psi is non-singular if it is nonzero on the root spaces g_alpha for all simple roots alpha in Delta.

nodes.name: Whittaker vector
nodes.statement: An element v of a g-module V is a Whittaker vector of type psi if xv = psi(x)v for all x in n. The space of Whittaker vectors in V is denoted Wh V.

nodes.name: Whittaker module
nodes.statement: Cyclic modules generated by Whittaker vectors of type psi are called Whittaker modules of type psi. They are singular or non-singular depending on whether psi is singular or non-singular.

nodes.name: Levi subalgebra l_psi and parabolic subalgebra p
nodes.statement: For a Whittaker character psi, let Delta_psi be the set of simple roots alpha for which psi(g_alpha) != 0. The reductive subalgebra l = l_psi is generated by h and the root spaces g_alpha with +/-alpha in Delta_psi. The parabolic subalgebra p = l + n has a unique ad(h)-stable decomposition p = l + m, and g = m_bar + l + m.

nodes.name: Induced l-module Y_{Omega,psi}
nodes.statement: For an arbitrary central character Omega: Z(l) -> C, the induced l-module Y_{Omega,psi} = U(l) otimes_{Z(l)U(l_+)} C v_{Omega,psi}, where Z(l)U(l_+) acts by the characters Omega and psi. This module is simple as a U(l)-module.

nodes.name: Whittaker module M_{Omega,psi}
nodes.statement: The Whittaker module M_{Omega,psi} = U(g) otimes_{U(p)} Y_{Omega,psi} is obtained by inducing the l-module Y_{Omega,psi} to U(g) via the inflation map p -> p/m = l.

nodes.name: McDowell's classification of simple Whittaker modules
nodes.statement: The module M_{Omega,psi} has a unique simple quotient L_{Omega,psi}, and every simple Whittaker module of type psi is isomorphic to L_{Omega,psi} for some character Omega: Z(l) -> C.
assumptions: g is a complex semisimple Lie algebra with standard Borel subalgebra and nilradical n
psi: n -> C is a Whittaker character
Omega: Z(l_psi) -> C is a central character of the Levi subalgebra
conclusions: M_{Omega,psi} has a unique simple quotient L_{Omega,psi}
Every simple Whittaker module of type psi is isomorphic to L_{Omega,psi} for some central character Omega

nodes.name: Partial order on z*
nodes.statement: A partial order on z* (the dual of the centre z of l_psi) is defined by eta <= mu if mu - eta is the restriction of an element lambda in Span_{Z_+}(Delta \ Delta_psi) to z.

nodes.name: Main Theorem: Simplicity criterion for Whittaker modules
nodes.statement: A Whittaker module V for g is simple if and only if the space Wh V of Whittaker vectors is 1-dimensional.
assumptions: g is a complex semisimple Lie algebra
V is a Whittaker module for g
conclusions: V is simple if and only if Wh V is 1-dimensional

nodes.name: Weight space decomposition of L_{Omega,psi}
nodes.statement: L_{Omega,psi} = direct sum over mu <= Omega_bar of L_{Omega,psi}^mu, where V^mu = {v in V : hv = mu(h)v for all h in z}.

nodes.name: Category N
nodes.statement: The category N consists of g-modules which are locally finite with respect to the action of n.

nodes.name: Bound on dimension of Whittaker vectors by composition length
nodes.statement: For any g-module M in the category N, the dimension of Wh M is bounded by the composition length of M.
assumptions: g is a complex semisimple Lie algebra
M is a g-module in the category N (locally n-finite modules)
conclusions: dim Wh M is bounded by the composition length of M

nodes.name: Universal Whittaker module Y_{chi,psi}
nodes.statement: For a central character chi: Z(g) -> C and Whittaker character psi, the universal module Y_{chi,psi} = U(g) otimes_{Z(g)U(n)} C w_{chi,psi}, where Z(g)U(n) acts on the 1-dimensional space by chi tensor psi. Any Whittaker module of type psi with central character chi is a quotient of this module.

nodes.name: Bound via universal module length
nodes.statement: The dimension of Wh V for any Whittaker module V of type psi with central character chi is bounded by the length of the universal module Y_{chi,psi}. These lengths have been computed by Milicic and Soergel using Kazhdan-Lusztig theory.
assumptions: V is a Whittaker module of type psi with central character chi: Z(g) -> C
conclusions: dim Wh V <= length of universal module Y_{chi,psi}
The lengths of universal modules are computable via Kazhdan-Lusztig theory (Milicic-Soergel)
